adql: SELECT phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, parallax, parallax_over_error FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 295.150637882025, 15.6402977460506, 0.1784124116152771)) AND phot_g_mean_mag < 21.0
note: Independent repeat of package query; transformed population actually used is separately hashed.
